headquarters: Vijaya Raje Vatsalya Bhawan, Arera Hills, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462011
description: The principal government organ focused on holistic development, health, protection, and empowerment of women and children through targeted flagship welfare schemes, Anganwadi networks, and legal protection cells.
sub_divisions: Directorate of Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)
Madhya Pradesh State Commission for Women
primary_functions: Execution of flagship financial assistance programs including Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
Implementation of Ladli Laxmi Yojana to encourage female child education and birth ratio balance
Operation and monitoring of Anganwadi Centers for child nutrition, early education, and maternal care
Protection of women from domestic violence, harassment, and societal discrimination
Management of Child Protection Services, One Stop Centers (Sakhi), and working women's hostels
key_services_offered: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) registration for Ladli Behna and Ladli Laxmi Schemes
Supplementary nutrition, growth monitoring, and pre-school education at local Anganwadis
Emergency shelter, legal aid, and counseling for distress women through Sakhi One Stop Centers
Adoption services regulation under CARA guidelines and child safety monitoring
